technique.smoothing: Savitzky-Golay 0.2 s; no gap interpolation; >=5 consecutive valid frames

method.delta: current minus reference; percent uses absolute reference
method.reference: median of available values, including current rep; not a technique target
method.mean_velocity: signed trapezoidal mean over valid adjacent ascent intervals; minimum 80% interval coverage
method.velocity: smoothed shoulder midpoint, positive upward, uncalibrated px/s; interpolated samples included
method.pause: contiguous bottom region: deepest 5% of hip excursion and <=10% peak absolute hip speed; minimum 0.2s
method.trend: OLS over original rep ordinals; minimum 3 available reps; descriptive, no fatigue or significance inference

repetition_method: Smoothed selected-side hip Y peaks; upright return and knee-angle checks. Complete cycles only; review suggested boundaries.
name: squat_test2.mp4

measurement.point: midpoint of left and right shoulders (chest proxy)
measurement.filter: Savitzky-Golay, polynomial order 2; differentiate after smoothing
measurement.calibration: uncalibrated 2D image; no conversion to metres
